name: malaria
description: A blood-smear image dataset for automated malaria parasite detection that provides labeled cell images (parasitized vs. uninfected) for training and evaluating vision models. It is intended to benchmark classification models for malaria diagnosis from microscopic images and supports metrics common in medical imaging classification.
reputation: Widely used as a baseline dataset in medical imaging and computer vision tutorials and research for malaria cell classification, though smaller and less diverse than large clinical benchmarks.
